items.headline: Heat Advisory issued August 20 at 4:01PM CDT until August 23 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX
items.label: Alert
items.detail:
* WHAT...Temperatures up to 104 and heat index values up to 112
expected.

* WHERE...The northern Hill Country, I-35 Corridor, and Coastal
Plains.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM CDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures and high humidity may cause heat
illnesses.
